get.summary: Reports that the service is running.
get.description: A liveness check only: it does not touch the database, so it stays green while a dependency is starting.

post.summary: Receives one message from a notification provider.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Name of the provider calling back, as used in List<string> NotificationOptions.EnabledProviders (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Only cases in this stage; all stages when omitted.

parameters.name: ownerReference
parameters.description: Only cases owned by this person or queue; all owners when omitted.

parameters.name: escalated
parameters.description: Only cases with (or without) an open escalation; both when omitted.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of cases to skip, for paging; zero when omitted.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Maximum number of cases to return; a server default when omitted.

get.summary: Returns the audit timeline of one case.
Lists the cases that currently need attention.

parameters.name: facilityId
parameters.description: Only cases of this facility; all facilities when omitted.

parameters.name: ownerReference
parameters.description: Only cases owned by this person or queue; all owners when omitted.

post.summary: Runs the escalation comparison on a simulated cohort.
Drafts a handoff summary for a case.

parameters.name: caseId
parameters.description: The case the summary belongs to.

parameters.description: The case the summary belongs to.

get.summary: Describes what the CareLoop FHIR boundary supports.
get.description:
Will list one entry per registered IFhirInboundMapper (create and update) plus read on
`Task`.

get.summary: Returns the current status of a case as a FHIR `Task`; also feeds the patient view.
get.description:
Field mapping: handoff status to `Task.status`; stage to `Task.businessStatus`; owner to
`Task.owner`; who handed over to `Task.requester`; the result or referral to `Task.focus`;
patient to `Task.for`; deadline to `Task.restriction.period`; rejection or closure reason to
`Task.statusReason`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CareLoop's case identifier, used as the logical identifier of the case `Task`.

post.summary: Accepts a new FHIR resource from an external system.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The FHIR resource type in the URL, for example `DiagnosticReport`; must match the body.

put.summary: Accepts a new version of an existing FHIR resource from an external system.
put.description: An update is state, not an event: the mapper derives the transition and the resource version makes a resend idempotent.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The FHIR resource type in the URL; must match the body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The logical identifier of the resource; must match the body.

approvedText.description: The text being approved. The approver may have edited the draft; what is approved is exactly this text.

ApproveSummaryRequest.description: Body of the request approving a drafted handoff summary.

sourceSystem.description: Identifier of the system that produced the result.

sourceResultId.description: The source system's identifier of the actionable result.

patientReference.description: Source-system reference of the patient. Never a name.

pathwayId.description: Identifier of the pathway the case follows.

facilityId.description: The facility that produced the result.

stage.description: The pathway stage the case is in.

urgency.description: The clinician-reviewed urgency code; `null` until the review arrives.

owner.description: The one owner accountable for the next action.

oneOf.description: The owner a transfer is proposed to, while a proposal is pending. The current owner stays accountable until it is accepted.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due.

isEscalated.description: `true` while the case has an open escalation.

exceptions.description: Names of the unresolved exceptions on the case.

tracks.description: The state of each parallel track.

outcomeEvidenceReference.description: Reference to the recorded outcome evidence, when there is any.

oneOf.description: The reason the case was closed; `null` while it is open.

CaseDetailResponse.description: The full coordination state of one case, returned by `GET /cases/{caseId}`.

CaseEventType.description: The kinds of event that can change a case.

CaseStage.description: The pathway stage a case is in.

patientReference.description: Source-system reference of the patient. Never a name.

pathwayId.description: Identifier of the pathway the case follows.

stage.description: The pathway stage the case is in.

urgency.description: The clinician-reviewed urgency code; `null` until the review arrives.

owner.description: The one owner accountable for the next action.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due.

isEscalated.description: `true` while the case has an open escalation.

exceptions.description: Names of the unresolved exceptions on the case; empty when there are none.

CaseSummaryResponse.description: One row in the case list returned by `GET /cases`.

patientReference.description: Source-system reference of the patient. Never a name.

exceptions.description: Names of the unresolved exceptions on the case.

stage.description: The pathway stage the case is in.

urgency.description: The clinician-reviewed urgency code; `null` until the review arrives.

nextAction.description: Key of the single next action.

owner.description: The owner accountable for the next action.

dueAt.description: When the next action is due.

overdueBy.description: How long the next action is overdue; `null` when it is not overdue.

isEscalated.description: `true` while the case has an open escalation.

escalationLevel.description: The highest escalation level reached; zero when never escalated.

ExceptionItemResponse.description: One row in the exception queue returned by `GET /exceptions`.

status.description: Where the summary stands with its reviewer.

sections.description: The sections of the summary, in reading order.

text.description: The sections run together as plain text; what a reviewer signs and what the HIS receives as a `DocumentReference`.

missingOrConflictingFacts.description: What the draft reported as missing, stale or contradictory, for a person to resolve.

humanReviewRequired.description: Whether a person must review this before it can be used. Always `true` while the status is `Draft`.

draftedBy.description: Name of the AI provider that produced the draft.

modelDeployment.description: The model deployment that produced the draft.

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt and template used, so a reviewer can tell two drafts apart.

trigger.description: Why the draft was produced: because a person asked, or because a handoff was proposed.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag the summary is written in.

approvedBy.description: Reference of the person who approved it; `null` unless the status is `Approved`.

approvedAt.description: When it was approved; `null` unless the status is `Approved`.

rejectedBy.description: Reference of the person who rejected it; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

rejectedAt.description: When it was rejected; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

rejectionReason.description: Why the reviewer rejected it; `null` unless the status is `Rejected`.

HandoffSummaryResponse.description: A handoff summary for a case, returned when one is drafted, approved or rejected.

HandoffSummaryStatus.description: Where a handoff summary stands with its reviewer.

status.description: Always `ok` when the service is able to answer.

service.description: Name of the service that answered.

openCases.description: Number of cases not yet closed.

closedCases.description: Number of cases closed with evidence or a documented exception.

casesByStage.description: Number of open cases per stage name.

casesByException.description: Number of open cases per unresolved exception name.

overdueCases.description: Number of open cases past their deadline.

escalatedCases.description: Number of open cases with an open escalation.

unassignedCases.description: Number of open cases in the facility lead queue with no named owner.

acknowledgementRate.description: Share of notifications the patient acknowledged, from 0 to 1; `null` when none were sent.

closureRate.description: Share of cases closed, from 0 to 1; `null` when there are no cases.

medianTimeToClosure.description: Median time from result received to closure; `null` when no case is closed.

workstream.description: The workstream that will implement the endpoint, for example `WS6`.

feature.description: The slice that is not implemented yet.

message.description: A short explanation for whoever called the endpoint.

NotImplementedResponse.description: Body returned with HTTP 501 by endpoints that are scaffolded but not yet implemented.

reference.description: Source-system reference of the person, or the queue identifier.

facilityId.description: The facility the owner belongs to.

isQueue.description: `true` when the owner is the facility lead queue rather than a named person.

OwnerResponse.description: The person or queue accountable for a case, as shown in the dashboard.

reason.description: Why the reviewer turned the draft down. Stored with the rejection and read when the drafts are evaluated.

RejectSummaryRequest.description: Body of the request rejecting a drafted handoff summary.

escalationEnabled.description: `true` when deadlines and escalation were active in this arm.

closedCases.description: Number of cases closed with evidence or a documented exception by the end of the replay.

stalledCases.description: Number of cases left without action past their deadline and never picked up.

medianTimeToClosure.description: Median time from result received to closure; `null` when no case closed.

SimulationArmResponse.description: The result of replaying the cohort under one condition (with or without escalation).

cohortScenario.description: Name of the cohort scenario to replay, for example `cohort`.

seed.description: Random seed overriding the scenario's own, so a run can be repeated exactly; `null` uses the scenario's seed.

SimulationRequest.description: Parameters for the with-and-without-escalation comparison started by `POST /metrics/simulation`.

cohortScenario.description: Name of the cohort scenario that was replayed.

seed.description: The seed used, so the run can be repeated.

withEscalation.description: The arm with deadlines and escalation active.

withoutEscalation.description: The arm with deadlines and escalation switched off.

SourceEventDisposition.description: What CareLoop did with a source event.

sourceFactIds.description: Identifiers of the facts the section was drafted from, so a reviewer can check each statement against its source.

SummarySectionResponse.description: One section of a handoff summary and the facts it rests on.

disposition.description: Whether the event was applied or refused (for example a closure attempt without evidence).

actorReference.description: The source system or actor responsible.

actorRole.description: The role the actor acted in.

sourceTimestamp.description: When the action happened according to the source.

oneOf.description: The stage before the event; `null` when the event opened the case.

reason.description: Why the change was made or refused.

evidenceReference.description: Reference to the supporting evidence, when there is any.

TimelineEntryResponse.description: One audit entry in a case timeline, returned by `GET /cases/{caseId}/timeline`.

TrackKind.description: Identifies one of the parallel follow-up tracks of a case.

status.description: The track's status name, for example `Delivered` or `Accepted`; `null` when the track has not started.

isComplete.description: `true` when the track has reached its completing status. Delivery alone does not complete notification; an accepted referral is still not completed care.

updatedAt.description: When the track last changed; `null` when it has not started.

TrackStatusResponse.description: The current state of one parallel track of a case.
